scripts.build:single: tsc -b && SINGLEFILE=1 vite build --outDir dist-single && mv dist-single/index.html dist-single/Bento_Dash.bento.html && node ../scripts/postbuild-compress.mjs dist-single/Bento_Dash.bento.html --generator bento-dash --title "bento/dash"
scripts.build:sealtest: rm -rf dist-sealtest && tsc -b && SINGLEFILE=1 BENTO_TEST_SEAL=1 vite build --outDir dist-sealtest && mv dist-sealtest/index.html dist-sealtest/Bento_Dash.bento.html && node ../scripts/postbuild-compress.mjs dist-sealtest/Bento_Dash.bento.html --generator bento-dash --title "bento/dash" && touch dist-sealtest/.complete
